name: Blueberry Pie
source:
One day main character receives a mysterious crystal ball on his journey. The hidden truth about reality is reflected in it. For example, it's shows how priest seals nun's purity just for her virginity to be taken by a tentacle monster.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
旅途中，主人公偶然得到一颗神秘水晶球。它能映照出现实背后隐藏的真相。例如，一名神父将修女的纯洁封印起来，最终却只为让触手魔物夺走她的处女之身。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
